jobs.title: AI Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT EMA

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned AI Strategist to lead strategic enterprise accounts and play a pivotal role in shaping high-impact AI engagements. This role will work closely with our Executive Leadership Team, providing leverage on our most important deals and helping drive transformative AI adoption across major enterprises. The ideal candidate has previously served as a Senior Engagement Manager (or equivalent) at a top-tier consulting firm such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or comparable management consulting firms, and is familiar with complex enterprise sales motions. You must be comfortable engaging at C-level, shaping AI strategy for customers, and partnering cross-functionally to orchestrate successful outcomes.


Key Responsibilities
Strategic Account Leadership

 - Own and drive AI strategy for high-value enterprise accounts 

 - Partner with executive sponsors, customer success, solution engineering, and product to deliver winning AI solutions.

 - Act as the strategic advisor to client leadership, helping define AI transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Deal Strategy & Executive Leverage

 - Work closely with the CEO, CRO, and broader leadership team to influence deal strategy and positioning on the most strategic opportunities globally 

 - Bring consulting-grade thinking to structure engagements, solution narratives, and commercial approaches.

 - Shape proposals, POVs, and strategic narratives to accelerate deal cycles.

Client Advisory & Relationship Management

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CDO, CXO) on AI-driven business transformation.

 - Navigate complex organizational structures and drive stakeholder alignment at executive and working levels.

 - Lead strategic workshops, discovery sessions, and executive briefings.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Collaborate with product, engineering, GTM, and delivery teams to align AI solutions with customer objectives.

 - Provide market insights and customer feedback to inform product roadmap and GTM strategy.

 - Mentor internal teams on consultative selling, strategic storytelling, and engagement design.

What You Bring
Requirement

 - Experience: 7–12 years+ overall, including time as a Senior Engagement Manager / Project Leader at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or similar.

 - Background: Strong experience in consulting-led enterprise strategy and transformation engagements.

 - Sales Motion Exposure: Familiarity with enterprise SaaS or AI/technology sales cycles is essential.

 - AI & Digital Fluency: Deep understanding of AI/ML applications in enterprise workflows (LLMs a plus).

 - Stakeholder Management: Proven track record advising C-suite clients and managing executive relationships.

 - Strategic Thinking: Ability to design business cases, assess ROI, and translate strategy into actionable execution.

 - Communication: Exceptional storytelling, structured problem-solving, and presentation skills.

 - Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional leadership teams in high-velocity environments.

Nice to Have

 - Prior exposure to AI, Generative AI platforms, or data transformation initiatives.

 - Experience working with high-growth startups or global SaaS companies.

 - MBA from a top-tier institution.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.


WHO WE ARE

Ema is building the next generation AI technology to empower every employee in the enterprise to be their most creative and productive. Our proprietary tech allows enterprises to delegate most repetitive tasks to Ema, the AI employee. We are founded by ex-Google, Coinbase, Okta executives and serial entrepreneurs. We’ve raised capital from notable investors such as Accel Partners, Naspers, Section32 and a host of prominent Silicon Valley Angels including Sheryl Sandberg (Facebook/Google), Divesh Makan (Iconiq Capital), Jerry Yang (Yahoo), Dustin Moskovitz (Facebook/Asana), David Baszucki (Roblox CEO) and Gokul Rajaram (Doordash, Square, Google).

Our team is a powerhouse of talent, comprising engineers from leading tech companies like Google, Microsoft Research, Facebook, Square/Block, and Coinbase. Most of our team members hail from top-tier educational institutions such as Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU and Indian Institute of Technology. 

Ema is based in Silicon Valley and Bangalore, India. 




WHO YOU ARE

Ema is hiring a Partner Manager to lead strategic GTM partnerships with SIs, VARs, Consulting firms, Cloud platforms, and AI ecosystem players. You will be instrumental in building and scaling a partner-led growth channel.

We’re looking for a seasoned professional with experience in developing strategic partnerships, enabling partners’ sales and technical teams, and activating GTM motion with large Tier-1 partners targeting Fortune 500 enterprises. You should have a track record of enabling large partner teams on Enterprise SaaS or AI-driven solutions and driving significant revenue through partnerships.

You will collaborate closely with the Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success team to drive Partner success, and act as the voice of the partner internally to advocate for partner needs and product feedback. 

This role is ideal for you if you’re entrepreneurial, data-driven, and relationship-first. You understand that great partnerships don’t just drive revenue — they unlock new capabilities and customer value. You thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution and are energized by shaping a new category of enterprise software.




YOU WILL

 - Identify, onboard, and grow key go-to-market (GTM) partners, including consultancies, resellers, cloud marketplaces, ISVs, and system integrators

 - Collaborate with partners to build joint value propositions and GTM plans tailored to priority industries and enterprise use cases

 - Lead partner enablement efforts, including training, certifications, and sales collateral

 - Serve as the partner’s advocate internally, sharing feedback to improve product and collaboration

 - Structure and negotiate partnership agreements, incentives, and success metrics

 - Drive pipeline through partner channels and work closely with sales teams on co-selling opportunities

 - Track joint deals, monitor partner-influenced pipeline, and measure revenue impact

 - Build and scale partner programs, including onboarding flows, partner portals, and reporting tools

 - Define partner success metrics and lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs)

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to support partner growth

 - Stay up to date on trends in enterprise AI and evolving GTM models

 - Represent the company at industry events, partner conferences, and ecosystem forums




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years experience in Partner management role at a SaaS, enterprise software, or AI company

 - Proven track record of sourcing, enabling, and scaling GTM partnerships that directly influenced sales outcomes.

 - Knowledge of partner program design, including incentives, MDF, and co-sell playbooks.

 - Deep understanding of enterprise sales motions, especially in AI and automation

 - Excellent negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder communication skills.

 - Strategic thinker with an ability to move fast and execute in a startup environment.




IDEALLY, YOU'D HAVE

 - Familiarity with agentic AI, RPA, enterprise workflow automation, or LLM-based platforms.

 - Experience working with cloud hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) or consulting/SI ecosystems.

 - Prior exposure to RevOps tools like Hubspot, Salesforce or PRM systems

 - Good understanding of software development principles, data structures, and algorithms.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a strong capacity for logical thinking.

 - The ability to work collaboratively in an extremely fast-paced, startup environment.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
ABOUT EMA

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.


ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline.

You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it.

We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional Event Planning

 - Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead.

 - Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam.

 - Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent.

Event Execution & Operations

 - Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe.

 - Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture.

 - Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI.

Pipeline & Sales Alignment

 - Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market.

 - Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion.

 - Make sure every event lead reaches Sales quickly and cleanly. No leads die on the vine.

Cross-Functional Coordination

 - Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience.

 - Support broader demand-generation campaigns as needed, including regional activations and partner co-marketing events.

 - Work across time zones with US-based marketing and leadership, with some early-evening calls.

Measurement & Optimisation

 - Track and report on event performance by market (leads generated, pipeline influenced, cost per lead, attendance, deal acceleration) and share insights to improve the program.

 - Obsess over what’s working vs. what’s noise, and use data to make the case for where we invest next.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5–7+ years of field marketing, event marketing or demand-gen experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, with a track record of running events in the UK and at least one other European market. Startup experience is required. You’ve built programs, not just inherited them.

 - A working knowledge of the European event circuit and what each market expects, from London tech weeks to Paris and DACH industry shows.

 - Exceptional project management skills. You can juggle 5+ events in different countries and stages at once without dropping a ball. You live in spreadsheets, timelines and run-of-show docs.

 - A roll-up-your-sleeves operator. You’re the person zip-tying cables to a booth at 6 AM, getting a pallet of swag through customs, and sending the recap email before the Eurostar pulls in.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You partner naturally with Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing and executives, including colleagues eight hours behind you, without needing to be managed into it.

 - Experience with HubSpot and marketing automation platforms to track attribution and ROI, and a practical grasp of GDPR as it applies to event data.

 - Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up day-to-day work, from drafting event briefs to analysing post-event data. We’re an AI company and we expect you to work like one.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving environments. Priorities shift, budgets change, events get added last minute, and you handle it. This is a fast growing Series B company. If you need a playbook handed to you, this isn’t the role.

 - High agency and an ownership mindset. As our first field marketer in Europe, you’ll see gaps and fill them without waiting to be asked.


LOCATION & TRAVEL

 - Based in/near London, working hybrid from our London office.

 - Travel up to 40% across the UK and Europe, with occasional trips to the US.
